subject: Post-demo: hosting decision & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: hosting decision & evidence checklist

Hi Alicia — great session this afternoon, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Primary ask we heard: MedSecure needs a HIPAA-compliant deployment path and a signed BAA before production traffic. You also wanted clarity on what SOC 2 artifacts we can share and roughly how each hosting option maps to audit scope.

2) Deployment options we covered (short):
- Hosted API (Redwood hosted): fastest onboarding, BAA + data controls (redaction/field-level restrictions), SOC 2 artifacts available for customer review.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): stronger isolation, dedicated tenancy and higher SLA, easier to map to your audit boundaries.
- Private VPC / on-prem: maximum control; will require a professional services engagement and additional timeline for validation.

3) Specific asks from your side we captured: BAA + redline; SOC 2 artifact list (control mappings + example policy excerpts); approximate cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted; procurement contact for on-prem scoping.

Attached: RDW_SOC2_artifact_matrix_v1.pdf (artifact index) and a BAA_template_redline.docx we propose as a starting point. I've also attached a rough hosting_pricing_sketch.xlsx to give order-of-magnitude numbers for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Next steps I propose:
- Alicia: confirm priority (BAA + Hosted with controls vs Dedicated evaluation vs on-prem scoping).
- Hugo / procurement: if you want a Dedicated estimate, can you share expected QPS and monthly token volumes?
- Marissa / Karthik: internal owners noted below — will prepare an evidence packet and an infra-capacity sketch respectively.

Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up tomorrow to align next steps.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Sean — thanks for the recap and for sending the artifacts. Appreciate the clarity. A few notes from our side: 

- We do process PHI across a subset of workflows, so a signed BAA is non-negotiable before any PII/PHI goes through the service.
- Procurement (cc Hugo) will want to see a clear delineation of what evidence/redaction controls you can operationalize in Hosted mode vs what is covered by Dedicated / VPC. If Dedicated is a reasonably priced option with a clear SLA, it's something our infra team will prefer.
- For on-prem, we need a statement of work estimate before we can engage legal — that will be a longer path but possible for certain regulated customers.

Hugo — can you share initial monthly token/QPS expectations? That will help Redwood produce a Dedicated sketch.

Also: compliance@medsecure.com will need the SOC 2 artifact list and a copy of the BAA template for legal review.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos

Alicia / Hugo — quick follow-up with two pragmatic paths and recommended next steps: 

Path A — Hosted (fastest):
- Deliverables: Signed BAA; SOC 2 artifact packet plus a short implementation note describing field-level redaction and allowed-data policies for the POC.
- Risk/controls: Good for low-risk PHI use with strict redaction and limited PII forwarding. Not as isolated as Dedicated, but lower time-to-value.
- Timeline: BAA + artifacts review: ~3–5 business days; POC on Hosted within a week of BAA.
- Cost: Most cost-effective; no infra commitment.

Path B — Dedicated (recommended if you need clear isolation):
- Deliverables: Dedicated GPU pool, customer-scoped tenancy, VPC peering or private network egress, SLA up to 99.9% (negotiable).
- Risk/controls: Easier to align to internal audit boundaries and to justify in your SOC/HIPAA narrative.
- Timeline: Provisioning + baseline testing: ~2–3 weeks once volumes are confirmed.
- Cost: One-time provisioning + monthly reserved commit; I attached an order-of-magnitude sketch.

Path C — Private VPC / On-prem:
- Deliverables: On-prem package and SOW; professional services for deployment and validation.
- Risk/controls: Maximum control and auditability.
- Timeline: Multi-week to multi-month depending on scope.
- Cost: Highest (professional services + Opex).

Ask: Hugo — can you share a 30/90 day token estimate and expected peak QPS so Karthik can produce the Dedicated sizing sketch? Also, Alicia — if test traffic contains PHI, please flag that now so we can prioritize BAA turnaround.

If it helps, I'm available for a 20-minute call today at 4pm ET or tomorrow morning to align.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
